description: Live full collection of the GovCloud staging account (us-gov-west-1, one region, 898 manifest entries, partition aws-us-gov) with the real Boto3Collector.run(), the collector's read-only identity and the read guard installed, writing to the local grid only, on the combined code of PR 199 (partition list, endpoint probe) and main (selection, progress lines). Counts, codes and booleans only; no account number, resource id or message.
script: not committed: a scratch wrapper around Boto3Collector.run() like tools/validate/selection_live.py, with no include_types

checks.the run completes with no run-log error: 2 runs, both: failed null, 0 error records
checks.progress lines reach the process log: [7a1d] start, [3e9b] every 30 s, [c52f] reads finished, [94d6] finished, in both runs

not_offered_candidates.what: 39 of the errored operations answer with a code that says the operation is not offered (UnknownOperationException, InvalidAction, UnsupportedOperation, a 404 route, OperationNotSupportedException, or a message saying so), each mapped to one manifest entry
not_offered_candidates.region_check: each was called once more in us-gov-east-1: the same code in every case where that region has an endpoint; iotsitewise, translate and comprehend have no endpoint there (EndpointConnectionError)
not_offered_candidates.why_not_listed: req-aws-collector-partition-8 leaves such entries unlisted because the service answers and the refusal costs no time, and the endpoint probe would report each listed entry as PARTITION_LIST_STALE because its host resolves

method: The two runs are the same code, run twice (the second with a dump of the call ledger grouped by service, operation and HTTP status). The classification of the 134 errored calls read the error code by calling each operation directly, once, with the read guard installed; operations were called without parameters, so those that need one returned ParamValidationError and are not classified; the codes are what a direct call returned, which can differ from what the collector's call returned. The call ledger records the HTTP status but not the error code.
